owner: GLEOR CATALOG CORE shared production rules

SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_GATE.scope: Every missing target view before any renderer call

field_states.DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED: Source directly shows enough evidence for target feature.
field_states.TRANSFORM_SUPPORTED: Known topology can be transformed without inventing identity; document derivation.
field_states.CONSERVATIVE_PRESENTATION_INFERENCE: Only non-identity-critical surface appearance; never holder/mechanism geometry.
field_states.OCCLUDED: Naturally invisible in target camera; state rationale.
field_states.SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS: Numerics unresolved but source topology/rhythm sufficient; document safe constraint.
field_states.UNSUPPORTED_IDENTITY_CRITICAL: Target-visible identity requires unavailable structural information.

rules: Any UNSUPPORTED_IDENTITY_CRITICAL blocks and consumes zero retry.
SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS alone does not block when safe topology constraint exists.
Every field needs source evidence and target visibility assessment; numerical precision is not invented.
OCCLUDED must refer to target camera, not merely source invisibility.
Prior QA failures do not establish missing source evidence by themselves.
Do not request new source when existing evidence safely supports target.
SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_GATE.failure: PRESENTATION_RECONSTRUCTION=NOT_ALLOWED; exact missing evidence, no plausible substitute.

may_control: finish appearance only in separate locked finish stage
GENERATIVE_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY.enforcement: Call renderer only through evidence-bound authorization wrapper. Prompt-only geometry instructions are not enforcement. No renderer call when source gate fails, receipt is stale or retry budget is exhausted.
GENERATIVE_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY.qa_role: Post-generation detection is additional protection, not generation authority.

requires: source sufficiency authorized for exact target/source/locks
RELEASE_GATE.nonapplicable: Explicit source-bound applicability record, never silent missing PASS.
RELEASE_GATE.binding: Each gate evidence bound to candidate SHA256; later edit invalidates affected checks.
RELEASE_GATE.publication: Only release wrapper invokes publisher. Withheld artifacts remain internal.
RELEASE_GATE.human_acceptance: Required for FINAL_LOCKED; release candidate is HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

implementation_limit: Evidence classification requires source-based visual judgment; executable guards validate completeness/binding and deny unsupported calls, not autonomous 3D perception. No live n8n integration claimed.
